externalAgents.name: OpenHands
externalAgents.rationale: High-value autonomous software engineering benchmark and execution platform. Runs out-of-process via Docker sandbox to isolate heavyweight dependencies and preserve Antigravity stability.

externalAgents.name: Goose
externalAgents.rationale: First-class native MCP agent with pluggable recipe support. Integrated via CLI headless runner and MCP server connector.

externalAgents.name: Aider
externalAgents.rationale: Benchmark leader in repo-map AST compression and git commit automation. Integrated via headless CLI mode (`aider --message`).

externalAgents.name: SWE-agent
externalAgents.rationale: NeurIPS 2024 academic gold standard for issue resolution benchmarks via Agent-Computer Interface (ACI). Operates in Docker container sandbox.

externalAgents.name: OpenCode
externalAgents.rationale: REJECTED — DUPLICATE CAPABILITY: Direct functional duplicate of native Antigravity coding agents (senior-fullstack-engineer, backend-engineer). Installing its full CLI runtime offers no novel capability over native specialists.

externalAgents.name: Cline
externalAgents.rationale: REJECTED — DUPLICATE CAPABILITY: Duplicate of native Antigravity IDE agent engine. Running a VS Code extension agent inside Antigravity creates unnecessary IDE-in-IDE recursion. MCP compatibility is already provided natively.

externalAgents.name: Qwen Code
externalAgents.rationale: REJECTED — DUPLICATE CAPABILITY & Quality Score (72/100) below default threshold (75/100). Duplicates native coding agent capabilities without adding architectural value.
